messages.text: Production and supplier operations needs one defensible decision for outside-processing PO closure by 2026-01-14; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside ordered, sent, accepted, invoiced, and paid quantities must all reconcile.
I found 49 EA on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0100 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000100 up to 49 EA, provided ordered, sent, accepted, invoiced, and paid quantities must all reconcile. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or leave_settled_po_open.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for production and accounting close windows is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R9 and the CASE-001 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-100.

Required closeout records: add the resulting Oracle reference, option, date, and constraint as a comment on the existing case file; and append one dated decision row to the existing audit tab; do not overwrite prior entries. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
